## [wakehealth.edu](https://www.wakehealth.edu) — Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist

**wakehealth.edu** is the official website of **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical system based in **Winston-Salem, North Carolina**. Here's an overview of what the site and organization offer:

---

### 🏥 Patient Care
Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center offers expert medical care and advanced treatments in Winston-Salem, NC. Some of the most frequently searched clinical services include:

- Comprehensive Cancer Center
- Heart and Vascular Center
- Orthopaedic Services
- Neurology and Neurosurgery
- Pediatrics
- Primary Care

Orthopaedic surgeons and specialists treat every type of orthopaedic condition with advanced techniques, and the system's experts include more than 150 pediatricians and pediatric surgeons specializing in more than 30 areas of pediatric medicine and surgery.

---

### 🎓 Academic & Research Mission
The site also connects to **Wake Forest University School of Medicine** (school.wakehealth.edu):

- Wake Forest University School of Medicine directs the education of nearly 1,900 students and fellows, including physicians, basic scientists, and allied clinical professionals.
- The school has a nationally recognized research program, garnering over $400 million in extramural funding.
- The School of Medicine is one of the most selective medical training programs in the nation and encompasses multiple programs, including MD, PA Studies, DNP, and biomedical graduate programs.

---

### 📱 Patient Portal — MyAtriumHealth
The portal for Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist patients is now **MyAtriumHealth**. With new features, this portal provides a more convenient experience to access your health information. You can sign in from the website or download the free MyAtriumHealth App in your App Store.

---

### 🔍 Find a Provider
With online doctor appointments and physicians in Winston-Salem, NC & surrounding areas, they make it easy for you to find care close to home.

---
